note: GM program numbers are 0-based (GM #1 Acoustic Grand Piano = 0). Rows are listed top of screen to bottom. Keys match ARCHITECTURE.md §4/§5. See docs/curation.md for the reasons.

scales.label: Pentatonic major
scales.reason: No semitone clashes, so any sweep sounds pleasant. Default.

scales.label: Pentatonic minor
scales.reason: Same no-clash safety with a darker, bluesy mood.

scales.label: Major
scales.reason: Familiar do-re-mi. More notes per screen, so finer pitch steps.

scales.label: Minor
scales.reason: Natural minor for a sadder colour, still easy on the ear.

scales.label: Blues
scales.reason: Minor pentatonic plus the blue note. Characterful, rarely harsh.

scales.label: Chromatic
scales.reason: Every semitone. Most precise for learning position, but clashes a lot.

programs.name: Acoustic Grand Piano
programs.reason: Instant attack, natural decay. The reference sound.

programs.name: Electric Piano 1
programs.reason: Soft bell-like attack. Clearly different from the grand.

programs.name: Vibraphone
programs.reason: Bright mallet onset that cuts through fast sweeps.

programs.name: Marimba
programs.reason: Short woody decay, so rapid notes never smear.

programs.name: Acoustic Guitar (nylon)
programs.reason: Plucked, warm, with a distinct timbre for its row.

programs.name: Pizzicato Strings
programs.reason: String colour without the GS synth's slow bowed attack.

programs.name: Orchestral Harp
programs.reason: Clean pluck that rings nicely in legato mode.

programs.name: Banjo
programs.reason: Bright twang. The bottom row is unmistakable.

programs.name: Electric Piano 1
programs.reason: Gentle Rhodes-style tone, quick to speak.

programs.name: Vibraphone
programs.reason: Soft shimmer at low volume.

programs.name: Music Box
programs.reason: Delicate and high. Pleasant even when busy.

programs.name: Kalimba
programs.reason: Round thumb-piano pluck with a short tail.

programs.name: Orchestral Harp
programs.reason: Calm pluck with a long natural ring.

programs.name: Pad 1 (new age)
programs.reason: The only pad kept: it has a bell attack, so it still tracks the cursor.

programs.name: Celesta
programs.reason: Sparkly, very short, ideal for fast motion.

programs.name: Glockenspiel
programs.reason: Piercing onset, easy to localise by ear.

programs.name: Marimba
programs.reason: Woody mid-range anchor.

programs.name: Xylophone
programs.reason: Drier and brighter than marimba, so it's distinct.

programs.name: Tubular Bells
programs.reason: Big bell row. Rings long, so it works best slowly.

programs.name: Kalimba
programs.reason: Soft pluck that contrasts with the hard mallets.

programs.name: Steel Drums
programs.reason: Bright, unique colour for the bottom row.

programs.name: Acoustic Grand Piano
programs.reason: One row, so only pitch is heard. Best for learning X first.

instrument_sets.label: Full GM library
instrument_sets.reason: v1 behaviour, kept for completeness. Many slow or noisy programs.
